items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, or monetization expansion. Revenue is supported only for 2026-09-21: 6,219 Amazon clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue claims, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unsupported. The 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 AI ledger records $945.24728605 across 5,264 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but it cannot be compared with one revenue day or allocated to profitable outcomes. Do not retain the proposed 0xroulette.com CTA or markitdown work this cycle; neither has an evidenced financial return, and delivery is already saturated at 10/10 slots.

Financial measurement disposition: contribution margin, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unknown. The minimum evidence is a dated ledger matching each revenue item and allocated AI, infrastructure, domain, and operating cost to the same site or content and period, plus an approved learning threshold per experiment. Monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank in the brief; no budget variance or exposure can be calculated. Continue the existing period-aligned reconciliation only and preserve aggregate Amazon income as unattributed.
